questions.question: Can the complete internal HTML be published unchanged?
questions.answer: No. The 23.5 MB file embeds source inventory archives, owner setup and internal work. Public pages require a release-bound content allowlist.

questions.question: Does metadata search stop disclosing references if its grants change while ranking?
questions.answer: The original loopback probe disclosed two references after revocation and is retained. The repair binds the initial grant revision and revalidates it at completion; revocation, replacement and entitlement changes refuse. Local checks and a removed-guard control pass. Hosted behavior and recalling bytes already sent are not claimed.

questions.question: Do generated harness folders prove native context loading?
questions.answer: No. The current provisioner writes instructions, task.json, provisioning.json and empty contracts/artifacts folders. Bodies are not included by default, and offered, placed, loaded, used and helpful are different observations.

questions.question: Is a self-improving retrieval engine already integrated and qualified?
questions.answer: No. AutoRAG 2 is the leading documented trial candidate. Its external adapter, original-source mapping and held-out feedback benefit remain unqualified.

questions.question: Must a new domain be purchased before continuing?
questions.answer: The owner reports owning baltor.ai. Baltor is a candidate public brand; Loop Engine repository and runtime names remain unchanged. Naming and ownership checks precede any deployment or rebrand.
